messages:
maya_support: @payments-team urgent — Acme Corp (acct: ACME-98) invoice INV-2026-4321 failed to capture. Customer attached PO PO-9938. UI shows 3DS redirect loop, provider returned decline_code=insufficient_funds on one attempt. Customer is on contract, wants same-day resolution.

tom_payments: Can you paste gateway txn id + raw provider response? Also which card last4?

maya_support: Gateway txn: gw_txn_0x9f12ea, provider=StripeConnect, card_last4=4242. Raw response block:
```\n{
  "id": "gw_txn_0x9f12ea",
  "status": "requires_action",
  "decline_code": "insufficient_funds",
  "three_d_secure": {
    "required": true,
    "status": "redirect_loop",
    "acs_error": "redirect_cycle_detected"
  }
}
```\n
liam_engineer: From the logs it looks like two flows: one txn returned insufficient_funds immediately, another began 3DS but the ACS kept redirecting back to our iframe (redirect loop). Might be ACS misconfiguration at the bank.

maya_support: Repro steps we saw from customer: 1) Open invoice in hosted-pay 2) Click Pay -> redirect to bank 3) 3DS challenge iframe appears, then iframe reloads repeatedly and user sees a spinner. Tried on Chrome and Safari, same result. Customer tried another card, got insufficient_funds.

jess_billing: Customer insists PO covers the invoice and that we should mark it paid if payment flow is failing. What is policy for PO-backed invoices? Can we do manual settlement while payments team investigates?

tom_payments: We have two options: A) escalate to provider to fix ACS redirect (recommended) B) manual settlement (finance approval required). For hosted invoices we normally mark payment_attempt_failed and surface manual-pay link. For enterprise customers with PO, billing can approve manual settlement.

liam_engineer: Next technical steps I recommend: 1) grab ACS logs from provider (need provider to forward ACS debug dump), 2) re-initiate the 3DS session server-side with a fresh auth_session_id to rule out session reuse, 3) temporarily increase redirect timeout to 45s to see if it's a timing issue. I've opened provider ticket PAY-6789.

maya_support: Thanks — opened internal billing ticket REDWOOD-INV-PAID for manual settlement request and attached PO. Customer asked for same-day if provider can't confirm capture soon.

jess_billing: Approved manual settlement up to $125.00 once legal confirms PO terms. Please attach PO scan and note in billing ticket.

tom_payments: Assigning follow-ups: @liam_engineer (investigate 3DS sequence + provider logs), @jess_billing (manual settlement + legal signoff). I'll escalate PAY-6789 to provider priority P1.

payments-bot: Provider ticket created: STRP-13456. Provider requests ACS server logs and full browser trace. ETA: 24h.

liam_engineer: Quick note from initial trace: our server got a sequence of redirects: merchant -> acs1.bank -> acs2.bank -> acs1.bank -> 302 back to iframe start. That pattern is classic ACS routing glitch. If provider confirms, they will contact the acquiring bank.

maya_support: Customer updated: they're OK with manual settlement if we can confirm PO and mark paid; otherwise they will open dispute on their side tomorrow. Please keep me posted so I can update acct team. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tom_payments: Will update thread when provider replies. For now, please collect: merchant PO scan (attached to REDWOOD-INV-PAID), screenshots of the redirect loop, and browser console HAR. That will speed provider debugging.

jess_billing: Uploaded PO to billing ticket. Finance will fast-track signoff once legal confirms header.

maya_support: Adding HAR and quick video from customer to REDWOOD-INV-PAID.

payments-bot: STRP-13456 status=PENDING_ACS_LOGS. Provider assigned to payments-ops team.

tom_payments: TL;DR: likely bank-side ACS redirect loop + intermittent insufficient_funds. Plan: provider escalation (collect ACS logs), manual settlement if provider can't capture. Assigning owners and next steps above.

maya_support: Thanks everyone — I'll keep customer in the loop and ping if they escalate. :thumbsup:
